title: CSEval: Towards Automated, Multi-Dimensional, and Reference-Free Counterspeech Evaluation using Auto-Calibrated LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the quality of counterspeech (e.g., relevance, coherence, and aggressiveness) to combat online hate speech. While the dataset contains examples related to religious identity (such as Islamophobia), the study benchmarks linguistic and argumentative quality rather than theological, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
